purpose: Test fresh market-neutral intraday cross-sectional effects in liquid US equities after futures, ETF and FX single-market lanes failed D0.

data.gap_policy: No interpolation, forward fill, substitute signal, substitute entry or alternate exit. A daily cross-section is eligible only if all eight names have every exact timestamp required by that family.

portfolio.construction: Each valid signal day ranks all eight names by the frozen feature. Long the bottom two and short the top two for reversion families; long top two and short bottom two for momentum family. Equal weight across four legs; gross exposure normalized to 1.0, net exposure 0.
portfolio.daily_return_bps: mean of the four signed leg returns in bps minus frozen all-in round-trip friction per leg
portfolio.reversed_same_ranking_control: Swap long and short sides using the exact same ranked cross-section and timestamps; pay identical friction.

EQ_H1_OPEN30_CROSSSEC_REVERSION.ranking: ascending feature across all eight names
EQ_H1_OPEN30_CROSSSEC_REVERSION.position: long bottom two, short top two

EQ_H2_FIRSTHOUR_CROSSSEC_MOMENTUM.ranking: ascending feature across all eight names
EQ_H2_FIRSTHOUR_CROSSSEC_MOMENTUM.position: long top two, short bottom two

EQ_H3_OVERNIGHT_GAP_CROSSSEC_REVERSION.feature: log(current 09:30 ET open / previous valid session 15:59 ET close)
EQ_H3_OVERNIGHT_GAP_CROSSSEC_REVERSION.ranking: ascending feature across all eight names
EQ_H3_OVERNIGHT_GAP_CROSSSEC_REVERSION.position: long bottom two, short top two
EQ_H3_OVERNIGHT_GAP_CROSSSEC_REVERSION.prior_close_rule: exact previous valid US regular session 15:59 close for each name

gates.promotion: No direct promotion from D0 or D3. A survivor gets a new candidate ID and prospective future shadow only.
